method: Second reads of four families holding live complete-coverage RASTER_PASS receipts. Per family: claim asserted and released through claim.mjs; all fifteen obligations measured from bytes and records in this container — nine counters re-run, artifact and raster hashes recomputed, flattened widget appearances decoded from the fixture bytes (never from actual-writes.json), boundSource SHA-256s recomputed from corpus bytes, and the raster receipt's pinned canonical/boundary hashes recomputed from disk. No verdict inherited from any prior read.

verdicts.notes: First read of this family with the corpus mounted: TF-805 source hash recomputed from bytes and equal to every record. All 15 obligations pass. Two recorded deviations, neither an obligation failure: reports/participant-name-placement.json and reports/charge-caption-proof.json describe an earlier fixture iteration (stale personas, a partyNames prefill that no longer exists) and were not relied on — placement was re-measured from the decoded appearance streams; and the known boundary-apostrophe font-encoding advisory.

vf06's sole FAIL (FEE_AND_WAIVER) re-measured on identical committed text: the fee line is a dedicated delegation to the named clerk of the court that handled the case ('Ask the clerk what fee applies, if any', with the clerk named in the sentence above it), which passes under the house standard — vf06's 'catch-all ... without naming who to ask' characterization does not match the line; divergence quoted and reasoned in the row. Boundary JDF-477/Address is byte-proven empty and is an honestly RECORDED unfittable refusal (244.4pt needed vs 242.67pt at the 6pt floor) — the boundary fixture doing its job per factory precedent, recorded as a deviation. The CBI checkbox tick was proven to be the pinned source's own authored value by opening the corpus AcroForm.

vf01's sole FAIL (SERVICE) re-measured with evidence vf01's container lacked: the full text of the pinned TF-810, read from the corpus bytes, shows a correction request with no certificate of service, no serve-a-copy direction and no opposing party — the form closes its own loop ('Instructions to Court Clerk: Email this request and final disposition order to the HelpDesk', response block back to the requestor), so no service step is owed and the instructions state the complete path the form prescribes. Divergence reasoned in the row; a one-line explicit 'no one needs to be served' is noted as an improvement, not an omission.

verdicts.smallestExactRepair: In exactly four files, change the familyId value 'mi-setaside-marihuana-set' to 'mi_setaside_marihuana-set' and nothing else: data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/mi/mi-setaside-marihuana-set--official-pdf-fill/product-wiring.json (line 3, the closest line the packet has: "familyId": "mi-setaside-marihuana-set"), .../local-filing-variation.json, .../reports/shared-vocabulary-gaps.json, .../reports/squashed-caption-band-findings.json. Records-only: no fixture byte changes, so the RASTER_PASS receipt's pinned hashes remain valid and no rerender is needed.
verdicts.notes: Neither prior conclusion inherited. Re-measured: the vf01 ROUTE_IDENTITY finding REPRODUCES on current bytes — 4 of 16 records still carry the hyphenated familyId while the worklist, ledger and raster queue key on the underscore form; the route itself is the correct single route in every record that names one, confirming 'spelling variance, not a wrong route' — but an identity key that misses an exact-match lookup still fails the obligation until corrected. The vf01 SERVICE finding does NOT reproduce: the PF16 rebuild added the four-step service section (mail to the prosecuting official, sworn Certificate of Mailing afterwards, in the form's own order), confirmed against instructions 5-8 of the pinned form's instruction sheet read from the corpus. The other 14 obligations pass, fee stated from the form's own instruction 6 ('There should be no filing fee').
